trigger: The first stable-prefix result decoded three agreeing AVI counters at 94713 frames, but the complete 72015733-byte XYPT_L0001.csv contains 1658275 nonempty numeric rows and no header row, so the header-dependent parser returned no trigger count.
sourceBasis: The preregistered NIST X4 primary paper defines XYPT as four comma-separated ASCII columns ordered X position, Y position, Power, Trigger and names the files XYPT_L0XXX.csv. It also defines Trigger as an eight-channel decimal bit mask and states that value 2 fires the melt-pool camera.

authorizedParserChange.headerlessRule: If and only if every nonempty CSV row contains exactly four finite numeric fields, interpret columns 0-3 as X, Y, Power, Trigger in the primary-paper order.
authorizedParserChange.triggerValidity: Every fourth-column value must be an integer from 0 through 255. Any violation stops parsing; no row may be skipped.
authorizedParserChange.counts: Report all nonzero Trigger rows, value-2 rows, every distinct Trigger-mask count, total rows, first and last nonzero row, member SHA-256, size, and CRC-verified archive lineage.
authorizedParserChange.network: Re-read only the XYPT central directory, local header, and complete L0001 compressed member. Reuse the already sealed stable AVI header counters; do not request either AVI prefix again.

notChanged: The per-frame slot-key and exact-null singleton requirements
